map.8 项经典认知子测验，逐项换算常模百分位，汇总为记忆·注意·加工速度·执行四维能: 8 classic cognitive subtests, each converted to a norm percentile, aggregated into a memory-attention-processing speed-executive four-dimension ability radar chart and a 0-100 composite brain index. Everything runs locally in the browser, no internet needed, no data uploaded.
map.📖 查看「Human Benchmark 认知基准测评使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Human Benchmark Cognitive Baseline Test
map.每项子测验得到原始分后，按人群正态常模（均值 μ、标准差 σ）换算百分位：分数越: After each subtest yields a raw score, convert to a percentile by the population normal norm (mean μ, SD σ): for lower-is-better, percentile = 1 - Φ((x-μ)/σ); for higher-is-better, percentile = Φ((x-μ)/σ), where Φ is the standard normal CDF. The four abilities = weighted aggregation of subtest percentiles (memory 30% / attention 25% / processing speed 25% / executive 20%); the composite brain index = the four-dimension weighted mean (0-100), equivalent to 'you beat x% of people'. Norms are published-literature empirical values, for self-reference only, not equivalent to medical or clinical diagnosis. Random delays and target positions use crypto.getRandomValues; feedback sound uses AudioContext.
map.点击任意子测验开始；清空当前测验随时可重做，8 项全部完成后自动生成报告。: Tap any subtest to start; clear the current test to redo anytime; after all 8 are done a report is auto-generated.
map.选择上方一项子测验，或点击「依次完成全部 8 项」开始测评。: Select a subtest above, or tap 'Complete all 8 in sequence' to start the assessment.
map.尚未完成足够子测验。请先在「测验」页完成至少 1 项，完成 8 项后可生成完整四: Not enough subtests completed. Please finish at least 1 on the Test page; after all 8 you can generate the full four-dimension radar chart and composite index.
map.综合脑力指数（你击败了 —% 的人）: Composite Brain Index (you beat —% of people)
map.📌 认知表现受睡眠、情绪、设备与年龄影响很大，单次结果仅供娱乐与自我参照；重复练: 📌 Cognitive performance is heavily affected by sleep, mood, device and age; a single result is for entertainment and self-reference only; repeating practice itself raises scores (practice effect), so a rising history curve does not equal real ability growth. This tool stores no data on any server.
map.反应时测试：测量对视觉刺激做出点击的延迟，取多次中位值作为反应速度参考。: Reaction-time test: measures the delay to click on a visual stimulus, taking the median of multiple trials as a reaction-speed reference.
map.记忆类测试：数字/听觉/视觉记忆分别测不同通道的保持容量与准确率。: Memory tests: digit/auditory/visual memory each measure retention capacity and accuracy of a different channel.
map.朋友间横向对比：用同一套规则的成绩做趣味排名，观察各人强弱项差异。: Friend lateral comparison: use the same-rule scores for a fun ranking, observing each person's strength/weakness differences.
map.5 次反应时 268/251/243/259/247 ms，去掉极端后中位约 2: 5 reaction times 268/251/243/259/247 ms, median about 251 ms after dropping extremes; reaction time is affected by device, input latency and state, for relative reference only.
map.反应时测感知-动作延迟，数字/听觉/视觉记忆分别测不同通道的短时保持，属于多维度: Reaction time measures perception-action latency; digit/auditory/visual memory measure short-term retention of different channels; multi-dimensional self-rating, not pointing to a single ability.
map.成绩能和别人比吗？: Can scores be compared with others?
map.可以作趣味对比，但跨设备、跨状态的延迟差异很大，排名仅具娱乐参考意义。: Yes for fun comparison, but cross-device and cross-state latency differences are large; ranking is for entertainment reference only.
map.不能。这些是单维小测验的娱乐合集，不构成智力或能力评估，正式测评需专业机构。: No. These are entertainment collections of single-dimension mini-tests, not an intelligence or ability assessment; formal assessment needs a professional institution.
map.关于「Human Benchmark 认知基准测评」: About Human Benchmark Cognitive Baseline Test
map.集合反应时、记忆、预测等多维单人小测验，横向比较个人认知表现，属娱乐性自评。: A collection of multi-dimension solo mini-tests - reaction time, memory, prediction - comparing personal cognitive performance laterally, an entertainment self-rating.
